Committee: State Government
Sponsor: Moore (P)
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 02/03/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 151 as introduced could reduce potential receipts to various professional licensing boards by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of fees waived for spouses of employees of U.S. Department of Justice and National Aeronautics and Space Administration that seek reciprocal licensure pursuant to the provisions of the bill.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government

Committee: Veterans and Military Affairs
Sponsor: Moore (P)
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 02/17/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 151 as passed the House of Representatives could reduce potential receipts to various professional licensing boards by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of fees waived for spouses of employees of the U.S. Department of Justice and the National Aeronautics and Space Administration that seek reciprocal licensure pursuant to the provisions of the bill.
Tom Butler, Chairperson
Veterans and Military Affairs
